findingText: Water leaking from TPR valve. Recommend correction as necessary to repair the problem.
The wood entry door is weathered and showing signs of finish deterioration. Recommend refinishing.
Wood damage is evident on a few of the railing spindles. Recommend replacement of the affected spindles.
Water staining and swelling observed on cabinet flooring beneath the sink. Recommend inspecting supply and drain connections for a slow leak.
Caulking at the tub-to-tile joint is cracked and deteriorated with visible mold growth along the seam. Recommend recaulking to prevent further moisture intrusion.
Attic insulation and ventilation appear adequate. No signs of moisture, staining, or structural concerns observed.
Discoloration consistent with overheating was observed at one breaker connection, along with corrosion on the adjacent panel surface. Recommend evaluation by a licensed electrician.
Roof covering and gutters at this section are in serviceable condition. No damage or debris buildup observed.
